apps.name: Cascade
apps.subtitle: PlayStation 2 Emulator for iPhone & iPad
apps.localizedDescription:
Cascade is a PlayStation 2 emulator for iPhone and iPad built entirely in Swift.

Run your legally-owned PS2 game library on iOS with a native Liquid Glass interface, on-screen DualShock 2 controller, save states, cheat codes, and more.

Features:
• Full MIPS R5900 Emotion Engine emulation
• Software rasteriser via Metal
• 48-voice SPU2 audio
• ISO, BIN/CUE and CHD v5 disc images
• 8 save-state slots per game
• GameShark / CodeBreaker cheat codes
• Physical MFi & Bluetooth controller support
• On-screen DualShock 2 controller
• Game library with collections & favourites
• Crash reporter with shareable logs
• iOS 26 Liquid Glass UI — degrades gracefully to iOS 16

Requires a legally-dumped PS2 BIOS and your own game images.

versions.localizedDescription:
